behaviors.execution_owner: Per-follower heartbeat goroutine launched by replicate
behaviors.protocol_context: One followerReplication object with fixed request term s.currentTerm; peer address read under peerLock on each iteration
legal_preconditions: replicate has started this heartbeat worker
implementation_guards: Transport errors enter backoff without refreshing contact
important_branches: Any error-free response refreshes contact without a response-term comparison
An unsuccessful response still refreshes contact but supplies false to notifyAll
existing_protections: Verification notification uses response Success, not mere RPC completion
Ordinary replication separately detects newer response terms
unknowns: Transport response production, timing and cancellation under network fast path need exact reading.

This consumer establishes a connectivity decision; stronger authority validity is not established by its timestamp check.

facts.meaning: For this replication object, a heartbeat AppendEntries RPC completed without a transport error and refreshed contact time. This does not assert acceptance of the sender as leader or successful log replication.

identity.peer: peer identity read for this RPC
